text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho, the first leg 
of the Classics. Gold Ship was in a foul 
mood. It seems she simply couldn't accept 
that the "Satsuki (May) Sho" takes place 
in April...

Charging headlong in a completely bizarre 
direction, Gold Ship was determined to win 
and rename the Satsuki Sho to the Uzuki 
Sho.
